entities.name: Sirimavo Bandaranaike
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of Sri Lanka (1960–1965, 1970–1977). SLFP; world's first female PM; widow of S.W.R.D.; socialist policies; 1971 JVP uprising crushed; 1972 republic (Ceylon → Sri Lanka); mother of Chandrika; later PM again 1994-2000; died 2000
